definitions.explanation: An unexpected meeting or encounter, often with something unpleasant, dangerous, or noteworthy. Carries a stronger, more dramatic nuance than simply meeting someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭遇|そうぐう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{思|おも}いがけない⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭遇|そうぐう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised to come across an unexpected scene.

examples.japanese: {登山中|とざんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{雷雨|らいう}→雷雨：15922_raiu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭遇|そうぐう}し、⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{余儀|よぎ}なく→余儀なく：28255_yoginaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We encountered a severe thunderstorm while climbing and were forced to take temporary shelter.

notes:
USAGE:
{遭遇|そうぐう} typically implies an unexpected or dramatic encounter. It is often used with unpleasant or dangerous situations (wild animals, storms, accidents), but can also describe unexpected positive encounters.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭遇|そうぐう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to encounter/run into...)
- ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遭遇|そうぐう} (encounter with...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭遇|そうぐう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to encounter an accident)
- ⟦{野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遭遇|そうぐう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to encounter a wild animal)
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遭遇|そうぐう} (chance encounter)
- {遭遇|そうぐう}{戦|せん} (chance battle, encounter battle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{出会|であ}う→出会う：02298_deau⟧ is the neutral, everyday word for meeting or encountering. {遭遇|そうぐう} is more formal and dramatic, often implying surprise or danger.
